simple.meaning: דָּאָה (dâʼâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to dart , i.e. fly rapidly.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across Deuteronomy, Psalms, Jeremiah, beginning at Deuteronomy 28:49. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דָּאָה (H1675).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H1675. daah [ דָּאָה ] verb fly swiftly, dart through the air (compare perhaps Arabic run vehemently (of camel)) — Qal Imperfect יִדְאֶה Deut 28:49 2 t.; וַיֵּ֫דֶא Psa 18:11 (> || 2Sam 22:11 וַיֵּרָא ); fly swiftly, dart , of eagle Deut 28:49 , in simile of swift army; of Chaldaeans camp. with eagle, in judgment against Moab & Edom Jer 48:40 ; 49:22 (in both || כנפיו פרשׂ ); of ׳י in theoph. Psa 18:11 (compare 2Sam 22:11 ) רוח עלכֿנפי וַיֵּדֶא (|| וַיָּעֹף עַלכְּֿרוּב וַיִּרְכַּב ).
